My recent encounter with Harmony Montessori in Lower Parel was profoundly disappointing. Despite their promises of a high-quality Montessori education, my experience fell far short of expectations. It's regrettable that Harmony Montessori fails to uphold the standards it claims to champion. Potential parents should approach with caution, as the reality of the institution's shortcomings falls far short of its advertised promises.

Terrible experience. The staff was so unwelcoming.

We had booked an orientation - we reached around 10-15 minutes late, because or which they informed us that we wouldn’t be able to see the school as it had already started - which i completely respect and understand. O asked them if we should come another day, to which she said that they would at least have the scheduled interaction.

However the interaction with the faculty was so superficial. The conversation started with a breakdown of the fee details, as opposed to talking about the school facility, pedagogy, and faculty - which other places did. I asked a few questions which they were completely disinterested in answering. I asked them how a Playway curriculum compares to a Montessori - their response was “You’ll have to do your own research”. If i was an educator myself, would I seriously come to you? A few other questions about timings etc, all they said “It’s on the website”. As a parent, are we not entitled to ask such questions?

A preschool is technically a child’s first foray into a structured academic set up, and it’s so important the place feel warm and welcoming. If i as a parent felt so judged and unwelcome, I can only imagine what it would feel like for my child to attend here.

I must stress that this was sooooo different from all the other preschools (I’ve checked out most preschools in South & Central Mumbai). At all the other places, they wanted to know about parents’ education, profession, their parenting philosophy, environment at home etc. The other schools also made so much effort on talking about their school and what they do.

Just for the record, we are a business family based in South Bombay - and by all means I would put us in the category of well-educated, affluent individuals who can clearly afford the fees. I would’ve so much happy had the school tried understanding us as and our child as individuals instead of constantly judging us.

featured_reviews.name: Niranjan Narayanaswamy
featured_reviews.review_text: By The Sea is such a fantastic institution—an oddity in our times. As a parent, I couldn’t be more at peace than having my child thrive in a secure, safe, invigorating space that celebrates her individuality and equips her with skills in a way that neither ‘talks down’ to her, nor thrusts it down. By The Sea allows the child to be and makes learning happen amid that happy space. With a strong and un-compromised set of core values, By The Sea ensures learning happens through play. Unlike several institutions that may cater to the ‘rat race’, By The Sea proudly doesn’t, which is why you would choose it over many, many others. Yet, the kids at By The Sea are independent thinkers and confident doers in every way. Their new space is dynamic and child-centric and their faculty and staff are very good with kids. The curriculum puts the focus on the child, on values, on principles,  without an iota of pressure on the young bright minds to learn through rote or ‘match up’ to comparisons. Every child is distinct and their individuality is celebrated and addressed at a one-on-one level. The learning is across skill-sets, disciplines and languages. featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Sood
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a parent of the school, words are always short for By The Sea. By The Sea is a treasure for every child and parent. This has been our experience and I hope sharing it with other parents will help.

THE MODULE: Being a 100% child-centric module, the institution puts the focus on the needs of the child rather than expectations of the world around them. Nothing is thrust upon the child, the child imbibes learning in a fun and bright environment. Each child is given individual attention, and is treated as their own rightful individual, rather than being just another in a room. Their needs, growth, skills, emotions-- are individually catered to. By The Sea’s innovative, dynamic and holistic ‘learning through play’ motto makes skill-development, cognitive development, motor-development and emotional-development happen alongside fun seamlessly without putting any pressure on the little ones and, as importantly, in a way that makes their wild young minds blossom like none other.

THE PRINCIPLES & VALUES: In our experience, their core principles and outlook make even little toddlers fiercely and fearlessly independent in thought and action in a way that they are confident and prepared to take on anything. As parents, what gives the most solace is that By The Sea builds a very strong value set in their children, and this is done immaculately by being the one thing that binds every action, activity, conversation and task. It is what glues it all together.

ROLE OF PARENTS: By The Sea is very transparent about the relationship between the Parent and the School, as well as the role of the Parents in the journey of their children’s learning. Quite simply, in our experience, being learners alongside your kids and being in sync with the Institution and their values is the baseline. Children at By the Sea are equal to adults, and there’s where it is essential as a By The Sea Parent to pledge to work with the stellar Faculty and the Staff to be on the same page and impart the same methods at home as in School.

ABOUT THE SPACE: About the New Space that By The Sea recently moved into, words fall short on how bright, open and child-centric it is. It caters to the needs and minds of the little ones without talking down to them in any way. The classrooms are large, with high ceilings and decked up with the work of the kids themselves-- this makes the By The Sea premises a living, breathing space which is constantly evolving with the wild imagination of children. The Space is divided into classrooms/activity rooms, a large free-play area stocked with everything from role play to trampolines to art corners to water play areas to activity tables and mats to a swing, slide and jungle gym area, and the list goes on. There’s also a lovely loft for the kids to play in which is a wonderful nook for quiet story book time with the Teachers.

If you are looking for a child-centric program that will put your child first and treat your child as an individual and not as one in the herd, and if you want to be life-long learners alongside your child as part of the process, there’s no better institution than By The Sea. Like I said, words are always short.

featured_reviews.name: Rhea Gursahani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Both my kids, Krrish and Koel have been with Da Vinci Montessori since Dec 2021 and we intend on continuing with the school as long as we are in the city and respective grades are supported by DVM.

Having experienced both the international and Montessori curriculums, I have seen my kids blossom into independent and opinionated individuals who also empathize and understand the situation around them, with the Montessori curriculum.

Koel was 14 months when she joined Da Vinci in the Toddler Class. 3 months ago, some of the students in Koel's class moved onto the Primary section. This also meant that several young kids now came to her class, and my little girl who once was a baby of the class transformed into the big sister. One day, as I was waiting to receive her, I was narrated a very sweet story by her teacher which touched my heart to the deepest levels.

As was informed, when the younger kids wanted something in class, Koel was the first one to notice, and she would stop whatever activity she was doing, to help the young child. One day, a young toddler was thirsty and made a gesture for the same. Koel noticed this from the other end of the class and ran to pour a glass of water for him. After sometime the young tod was thirsty again but instead of figuring what to do, he immediately went to look for Koel and asked her to pour him another glass of water.

Why I chose to share this story is because it very  beautifully depicts the empathy of the elder child and the independence of the younger one which all blossomed with their simple interaction in class. While the curriculum covers the knowledge aspect, it is these interactions of a mixed age classroom that really transform these young children into independent and caring humans.

Being the 2nd child and a COVID era baby, Koel did not enjoy as much Mama playtime and attention that her elder brother did, but, whatever she has learnt be it life skills, motor skills, empathy, language, knowledge has all been from DVM.

When Krrish joined DVM, he was 4.5 years old and we were returning from a post COVID era. If COVID was tough on us, it was worse with the kids who lost their sense of social being. Krrish was always pro learning but online schooling really got him disinterested in the concept of school. However, with the independence of choice given in the Montessori classroom, Krrish's love for school and learning was back. He was able to pick up the concepts quickly and now is a part of the Elementary class.

So while DVM is a beautiful option for Montessori what sets them apart are the people behind it and the genuine care and affection for the children and their well being. While the ideology is traditional the outlook is modern, to enable children to be successful in the fact paced, tech controlled life today!

Even while being a Montessori curriculum, the children are exposed to a variety of activities on par with international schools, such as Art, Speech and Drama, Physical Fitness, Capoeira, Spanish Music, in the Elementary classroom, and Music, Art, Fitness and Yoga in the Primary and Toddler classrooms.

The head of the school, Ms. Ashani, is deeply invested in ensuring that while the kids continue to learn from the Montessori classroom their future is safeguarded too, hence working on several tie ups with prominent big schools and introducing kids to a variety of inter school activities. The sincerity runs top down and the love, concern and nurturing can be seen in all members of the school from the administrator to each of the teachers in the Toddler, Primary and Elemnentary classroom, as well as the Didis!

I couldn't have asked for a better school for my kids! Thank you for making us a part of the DVM family!
